## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 12, 2026 - Sep 18, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _E D_, Sep 16, 2026, 1/5: "this app charged me for subscription without giving any notice to give me time to cancel the free trial and know I cannot go to the billing terms in the app. because it says no internet connection eventhough I clearly have internet. this is clearly a scam."
            2. _Geraldine Rolo_, Sep 18, 2026, 2/5: "Thank you for assisting me so promptly by refunding the money that was deducted from my account. please make it clear for other users that they need to manually cancel their subscription and not only unsubscribe via the playstore like we would with other apps. this was an unnecessary waste of time and money from my side."
            3. _Jordan Barham_, Sep 17, 2026, 3/5: "I enjoy how quick the exercises are - it makes it easier to fit into my busy day! However, it was just far too expensive. There are other apps that do similar for a fraction of the price. For that reason, I couldn't justify paying."
<!--/ir-theme-->
